spans.s: तन्त्रसारानुसारेण सृष्टि-प्रलयादिक्रमेण पृथिवीतत्त्वे - ब्रह्मा विष्णुः रुद्रः। ततः जलाद्य्-अव्यक्तान्त-तत्त्वान्तरेषु। ततः श्रीकण्ठः, कञ्चुकस्थ-रुद्राः, गहनेशः, ईश्वरः, सदाशिवः, शक्तिः, अनाश्रितः।

Every principle is composed of subtle elements (kalās). They are called nivr̥tti, pratiṣṭhā, vidyā, śāntā, and sāntātītā. The number of worlds in nivr̥ttikalā is sixteen; in pratiṣṭhā the number is fifty six; in vidyā the number is twenty-eight; in śāntā the number is eighteen. There are no worlds in śāntātītā. Thus, the total number of the worlds in all five kalās is one hundred eighteen.
